sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for project name matching
sections.what: Brings in the database helpers, the projects table, the name-matching function and the research name helper.
sections.why: Shows that the file reads the project list from the database and matches names against it.
sections.watch_out: Running this file touches the live database, so it depends on the database being reachable.

sections.name: scopedProjectAliases
sections.title: Builds the names a source uses for each project
sections.what: For each project in scope, collects the names that sources actually print, from imported research quotes and alternate names. Drops any name that is too short, reads like a description, or could match another project in the same scope.
sections.why: The comment says project records carry descriptive words no source prints, so only source-stated names are used, following a user decision dated 2026-10-29.
sections.watch_out: A project with no imported research names gets no aliases at all, so matching falls back to the project's own name.

sections.name: splitOutsideBrackets
sections.title: Splits a name list without breaking brackets
sections.what: Splits a list of names on semicolons, but ignores semicolons inside round brackets so that a bracketed note stays with its name.
sections.why: Recorded names can list several items, and brackets can hold their own separators.
sections.watch_out: Unbalanced brackets in the recorded text can merge several names into one.

sections.name: expandSourceName
sections.title: Expands one name into usable forms
sections.what: Turns one recorded name into the forms a source might print: the full name, the name without its bracketed part, and a short code when the bracket holds a single word. Also splits names joined by a slash, and drops results that are too short, too long or end in punctuation.
sections.why: Likely reason: sources print the same project in several forms, so one recorded name is expanded to cover them.
sections.watch_out: Route-style names with a place in brackets are treated differently from plain names, so changing that test changes which forms are kept.
